newsitem.title: MACEDONIA: MACEDONIA STOCK VOLUME, TURNOVER RISE.
newsitem.headline: MACEDONIA STOCK VOLUME, TURNOVER RISE.

text.p: Turnover and traded volume rose at Thursday's session of the Macedonian Stock Exchange, the exchange said.
Alkaloid joint stock company sold a total of 417 shares at 1,010 and 1,009 denars, down one from last trading and below par of 2,423 denars.
Turnover amounted to 61,610 denars at the previous session on Tuesday and traded volume was 61 shares.
Listed companies trade in two floor sessions. The exchange trades on Tuesday and Thursday.
